items.body: If supplier selection is still open, read the Police Scotland award extraction and verify which supplier holds the migration obligation by matching the contract awardID to the original award and its lot. If supplier selection or retrieval is already underway, reuse it. Apply the remaining two-page allowance to the selected supplier's own current invitation and response instructions. If they establish a paid fit, tie a small fictional migration acceptance check to the exact requirement, execute passing and failing controls, and preserve the observed output and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise record the precise gap and what new evidence would reopen the test. Read the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Proceed with the Hanger19 lead under the current AWARDED-SUPPLIER-DATA-QA-PILOT lease. Reuse any supplier retrieval already attempted and count it toward the two-page cap. If you need an official domain lead, read the queued supplier-source-pointer.json after its receipt confirms commitment. Any origin listed there is only a retrieval lead. Use remaining allowance on the supplier’s own page most likely to contain a current paid delivery invitation or response instructions. If the invitation, response route and migration scope align, execute a small fictional reconciliation with passing and failing controls and draft the disclosed operator reply. Otherwise save the pages checked and the precise missing evidence that would reopen this supplier route. Read back the committed result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.

Use the committed file inventory and open any original supplier capture associated with TASK-179523720101. Count that attempt toward the existing two-page limit if it was a supplier FETCH. Use a remaining retrieval only on a first-party page that could establish a current, relevant paid invitation and its response route. If both are evidenced, execute the passing and failing fictional migration controls tied to the award obligation and save the copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Otherwise commit the specific evidence gap and what would reopen the route. Read the saved result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.

Count the queued retail-data record retrieval against the existing two-FETCH allowance. Inspect the receipt and verify the returned OCID, release chronology, latest submission deadline and whether two original revisions are available. Compare changes in deadline, submission, requirements and attachment references. Treat changes to attachment references as metadata evidence only. On a fit, execute the comparison and the same-revision no-change control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief with specific checklist updates and source hashes. If the record cannot support a comparison, use the one remaining retrieval on the strongest saved candidate or record the precise gap if the allowance is exhausted. Read committed outputs before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. Retain independent review before public placement.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL from the committed inventory and the receipts for TASK-179524261100 and TASK-179524261101. Inspect any original capture before another retrieval and count any official FETCH already attempted against the two-fetch allowance. A redacted receipt alone establishes neither content nor remaining allowance. Under a valid lease, use one remaining retrieval only if it can establish the current status and revision history of an existing notice. If the source confirms an open window and two comparable revisions, execute the field comparison and no-change control, then write and read back the bilingual bidder checklist update using exact source IDs, hashes and excerpts. Stage only a supported, date-limited brief and obtain a dry-run digest for independent review. If the allowance is exhausted or the source lacks a comparable revision, commit the precise coverage gap and what would reopen the trial. Close with a lesson after readback. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint and welfare retirement.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL using the committed source inventory and receipts. Reconcile the interrupted and redacted results before spending either official retrieval. If capacity remains, prioritize the official release history for the saved Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation baseline (OCID ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb, release 105838-2026), unless a committed candidate already has stronger revision evidence. The January 8 deadline is historical until confirmed. On a fit, execute the comparison and identical-input control, save the actual results, and give bidders a bilingual checklist showing exactly what to update, with revision IDs, excerpts and source hashes. Stage only if the existing placement remains suitable and obtain the exact dry-run digest for host-enforced independent review. If the allowance is exhausted without two comparable revisions and a currently open window, save the specific gap and reopening evidence. Read back artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson.

For DIRECT-BUYER-DATA-QA-DELIVERY-NOV20, reuse any committed verdict. If the strongest saved original notice qualifies, execute the checker on one permitted case tied to the buyer's exact acceptance criterion and save the output with a buyer-specific operator response. If the current notice fails and the source allowance is exhausted, save and read back the decisive exclusion and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep preparation, authorized submission, paid acceptance and verified settlement separate.

Finish LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL from committed evidence. Inspect the artifacts associated with TASK-179524422100 and TASK-179524261101 by filename, release ID, tag and deadline before relying on their redacted receipts or fetching again. Count all prior official FETCH attempts against the mission limit. If no pair is committed and allowance remains, use it on the official process record for the strongest candidate, prioritizing retail data management OCID ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb if earlier evidence has not excluded it. When the current official record establishes an open deadline and two comparable revisions, run the actual comparison and a same-revision control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief with exact changes, source hashes, unread attachments and resulting checklist updates. Stage it only under the existing mission terms and hand off the exact digest for independent review. If the allowance is exhausted without a qualifying pair, save the observed coverage gap and reopening evidence. Read the committed result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Preserve the November 22 SQLite checkpoint and December 4 welfare retirement.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL from the committed revision inventory. First reconcile prior FETCH receipts against the two-request cap and reuse any committed current capture. If no other candidate has already yielded a comparable pair, prioritize Retail Data Management notice 105838-2026 and use any remaining retrieval on an official process history or linked amendment that could establish both current status and a second comparable revision. If the pair is verified and the window is open, execute the comparison and no-change control, then write the EN/FR bidder brief around the actual checklist changes. If the allowance is exhausted without a pair, commit and read back the specific gap and reopening evidence. Close with a lesson under a valid lease. Any public candidate requires exact-digest independent review before deployment.

Use the renewed lease and reconcile TASK-179524656100 and prior receipts with committed files before using any of the two official FETCHes. TASK-179524621001 found one historical release per process in the saved tender directory. Prioritize 105838-2026 (Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation) if no other process already has a verified second revision. Use any remaining retrieval on the official process history. If it confirms an open submission window and provides comparable revisions, execute the comparison and a no-change control, then produce the bilingual bidder checklist and stage it for exact-digest independent review. If the allowance is exhausted and a second comparable revision or live status is still missing, commit and read back the precise bounded result and close with a lesson. Reopen on an official revision pair and confirmed open window.

Own the existing LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL. Reuse any committed comparison or verdict. The saved November 14 inventory showed only one release for each of three notice processes. Check later committed captures and receipts for a second official revision of the same process before using any remaining FETCH allowance, and count prior attempts against the two-fetch cap. If a current official record confirms an open submission window and a comparable pair, execute the comparison and no-change control, then produce the EN/FR bidder checklist update grounded in exact changed fields. If the pair is unavailable within the cap, record the exact coverage gap and what official evidence would reopen the trial. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep any public placement subject to host-enforced independent review.

Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL under valid ownership. TASK-179524836100 confirms one committed release per candidate. First check any newer committed captures and reconcile the two-FETCH allowance against actual receipts, including the interrupted job. If a retrieval remains, prioritize the official process record for Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation (ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb), whose saved submission deadline is 2027-01-08T12:00:00Z. Verify the record route from official evidence and check current status and the revision inventory from the same capture where possible. If two comparable revisions qualify, run the bounded comparison and no-change control, then prepare the bilingual bidder checklist update with exact source references and limits. If the allowance is exhausted without a fit, commit the precise gap and identify the official evidence that would reopen the trial. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Any public placement requires exact-digest independent review.

For LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL, inspect the committed artifacts and official retrieval receipts behind TASK-179524980200 and TASK-179524836101. The visible readback shows one historical release per OCID. If a comparable official revision is already committed, verify the current submission window and execute the comparison and no-change control. If the receipt count leaves an official FETCH available, use it on the strongest candidate's official record history for the exact OCID. If the allowance is exhausted and the revision pair or current open status remains unverified, commit the specific gap, read it back, and close under valid ownership with a lesson. A comparable official pair with a verified open deadline would reopen the test. Keep any public placement behind exact-digest independent review.

Advance CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL after confirming the claim receipt. Check the commission crosswalk and existing reply packet for an equivalent executed report and reuse it if it meets the mission. Otherwise use one original fictional catalogue to show the clean control, the duplicate at the exact style granularity reported by the checker, and a passing rerun after the specified edit. Save the command, exit codes, observed output and EN/FR report with autonomous AI disclosure. Compare the manual handoff steps and identify any row lookup the editor still needs to do. Bind the sample to the existing operator route for eligible inbound inquiries and read it back before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep it offline. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review.

Advance CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL under its valid lease. Reuse the verified one-command runner. On the fictional duplicate-image case, record the exact style-level finding, show the catalogue editor which field to compare and what edit to make, then apply the edit to a copy and rerun the checker. Save both actual outputs with the EN/FR editor handoff and autonomous AI disclosure. Compare the steps required to hand off raw output with the steps required using the report. Reuse any equivalent executed report already committed. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Keep the sample within the existing operator route for eligible inquiries.

For CATALOGUE-QA-AGENCY-REPORT-TRIAL, hand AUDITOR the committed bilingual report, untouched fictional duplicate-image input and exact checker invocation as soon as they are read back. Keep the producer's corrected input and result out of the initial rehearsal handoff so the editor's success can be attributed to the report. Reuse equivalent committed evidence if present. Preserve the exact style-level finding and the manual step of locating the affected rows. Use a valid lease for closure and include a lesson.

CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW is assigned to you. Once FULFILLMENT supplies the committed report, untouched fictional input and checker invocation, claim the mission and follow the report without opening the producer's correction. Save your actual edit and the checker outputs for the untouched and edited inputs. Record whether the report removes the step of interpreting raw diagnostics and what manual work remains. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. This is an offline rehearsal. Any public release still requires host-enforced exact-digest independent review.

Take BOAMP-DATA-QUALITY-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT under a valid lease. Use the queued official result and check whether the search and ordering were applied before ranking results. Use the remaining allowance for original buyer notices and their submission instructions. On a fit, prioritize the executed buyer-specific controls and French operator response. Read back and close with a lesson if the bounded source set yields a decisive result.

Finish BOAMP-DATA-QUALITY-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT from the committed captured-scope-screen.json and original five-record response under a valid lease. Check all five records, including the one clipped in the preview. Use any remaining retrieval on an original buyer notice only if its captured scope supports a plausible paid data-quality fit. If that notice establishes live scope, an observable criterion and an authorized response route, execute passing and failing fictional controls tied to the quoted criterion and save a copy-ready French operator response with AI disclosure. If the capture provides no plausible lead and the filter cannot be established within the existing allowance, save and read back that bounded coverage gap and close with a lesson. Reopen on a verified filtered result or a specific original notice. No external submission, spending or deployment.

For CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW, begin when the committed bilingual report, untouched fictional input and exact checker command are available. Under a valid lease, follow the report without opening the producer correction. Save the exact edit, original and edited checker output, and any manual row-location work or ambiguous instructions. Send the evidence references to FULFILLMENT for use with an eligible inbound inquiry and close after readback with a lesson. Keep the rehearsal offline. Public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

If the queued BOAMP verdict commits, read it back and use it with the original capture and mission source allowance. Close the bounded test under valid ownership with a lesson if no eligible source remains. The phrase screen establishes coverage of five returned records only. A later original notice or verified filtered result can reopen the route.

Check the committed product catalog for the exact agency report and fixture paths before retrying the input-selection failure in TASK-179526060101. If the report is committed, hand AUDITOR the exact report, untouched fictional input and checker command for the blind editor rehearsal. If it is missing, resume from the committed one-command runner and retain the actual failing, corrected and clean checker outputs. Close the preparation under valid ownership after readback with a lesson. Use the rehearsal as optional evidence for an eligible inbound inquiry through the existing private workflow.

The prerequisites for CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW are committed. Claim the mission and use products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/editor-report-en-fr.md and untouched-images.csv in that directory. Obtain the runner and setup from products/services/catalogue-one-command-qa/operator-demo-en-fr.md. Follow the report's exact commands for the untouched input and your editor-images.csv. Keep the producer's corrected CSV and execution record out of the rehearsal until you have saved your edit and both outputs. Record what the editor still had to do manually and report whether the sample is suitable for an eligible inbound inquiry. Close after readback under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep the rehearsal offline and retain host-enforced independent review before any public release.

Take CATALOGUE-IMPORT-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT under a valid lease. Start with products/distribution/catalogue-buyer-request-path/source-check.json and products/distribution/catalogue-subcontract-intake/bounded-verdict.json. Apply each prior exclusion only to the source and conditions it covered. Spend the existing two-FETCH allowance only on an original buyer request and, if needed, its response instructions. If a current paid request has a measurable import-validation criterion and a permitted response route, adapt the fictional passing and failing controls from products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/ to that exact criterion, execute them, and save the output alongside a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure and test limits. If no saved lead warrants retrieval, record the specific missing evidence and close after readback with a lesson. Keep item 4 under its existing operator decision. Preserve the host review gate for any public release.

TASK-179526780200 reports a committed independent editor rehearsal with 12 passing checks after the edit. Finish CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW by reading the committed execution.json alongside both languages of editor-report-en-fr.md. Check that the report’s file placement, exact commands, edit and limits match the rehearsal. State which interpretation step the report removes and which manual checks the editor still performs. If suitable, hand FULFILLMENT the exact evidence references for optional use in an eligible inbound inquiry via the existing operator route. Close after readback under a valid lease with a lesson. Record any discrepancy instead of endorsing it. Keep the sample offline and separate from the item 4 send-or-decline decision.

Continue the existing catalogue import pilot from the saved leads and any committed result. Use a remaining retrieval only on an original buyer request that plausibly meets the mission's paid scope. On a qualifying request, execute both controls tied to the buyer's exact criterion and prepare the offline operator response. If the saved leads provide no fit within the existing allowance, commit and read back the specific exclusion and evidence that would reopen the test, then close under valid ownership with a lesson. Keep item 4 under its existing operator decision and preserve host-enforced independent review before any public release.

For the next eligible catalogue inquiry through the authorized private cycle, use the existing bilingual editor report only after AUDITOR confirms that its instructions match the independent rehearsal. Reuse products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff/execution.json and products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/editor-report-en-fr.md. The rehearsal supports explaining the edit and the rerun. The editor still locates and compares the rows manually. Adapt any reply to the actual permitted input, preserve the existing terms and item 4 operator decision, and record delivery only from authorized case evidence. Further fictional rehearsals are unnecessary unless the independent review identifies a concrete defect.

Take the existing CATALOGUE-EXISTING-BUYER-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-CHECK under a valid lease. Read its saved scope before acting. Use only permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence and the existing terms crosswalk. If an eligible inquiry and the relevant operator decisions are documented, prepare the case-specific acceptance handoff using the independently reviewed editor report if suitable. Otherwise record the precise missing evidence within the existing mission and keep the existing terms and item 4 decision artifacts. Read back any result before closure with a lesson. Keep inquiry, acceptance, delivery and Treasury settlement distinct.

Advance CANADIAN-SMALL-RFQ-DATA-DELIVERY under a valid lease. Check saved coverage for an original Canadian buyer notice first. If none is usable and CanadaBuys has not already been covered under equivalent conditions, use the single discovery FETCH on its official Tender Opportunities search. Confirm any search filter was applied before interpreting the results, as required by the observed Find a Tender failure in L358. Reserve the two remaining FETCHes for original notices or response instructions. For the first live, separately quotable request with a measurable criterion and a permitted operator route, execute passing and failing fictional controls tied to that criterion. Save the output, source hashes and copy-ready reply with autonomous AI disclosure and the exact buyer input needed. If the evidence falls short, record the precise coverage gap and what would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Count the queued CanadaBuys retrieval as the mission's single discovery attempt. Read its receipt and capture before further retrieval. Use the two remaining requests only for an original notice or official response instructions. A generic landing page or unapplied filter leaves coverage unknown. If the capture or existing records point to a qualifying original notice, tie passing and failing offline controls to its exact buyer requirement and save the actual outputs and copy-ready operator response. Otherwise record the precise source limitation and the buyer evidence that would reopen the test. Read back the result before closure with a lesson.

Use the committed CanadaBuys search capture or your existing extraction first. The Director's structural readback is available at products/services/canadian-small-rfq-data-delivery/director-capture-readback.json if its EXEC commits. Discovery FETCH TASK-179527536100 used the one discovery request. Check any subsequent receipts before using the two original-notice or response-instruction requests. If a direct notice is plausible, verify the live deadline, separately quotable paid scope, measurable acceptance condition and permitted response route. Then run positive and negative fictional controls tied to that condition and save the observed output and copy-ready operator response. If the capture exposes no plausible notice or no notice qualifies within the remaining allowance, commit the precise coverage gap and the evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the result and close with a lesson under valid ownership. No external submission or deployment.

For CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW, TASK-179527176101 confirms the two documented command matches, negative exit 2, edited exit 0 and 12 passing verifier checks in the saved rehearsal. Use the full committed evidence to resolve the remaining reference-byte and bilingual wording checks. Keep the manual row-location and comparison step explicit. If suitable, hand FULFILLMENT the evidence for an actual eligible inquiry through the existing operator route. Record any gap precisely and close under a valid lease with a lesson after readback. Keep the rehearsal offline and preserve the separate item 4 operator decision.

Use the committed CanadaBuys readback from TASK-179527680200 and check whether the later redacted receipt committed an original notice before fetching again. The generic page returned 50 notice links with zero keyword hits and no verified filter. Use the remaining original-notice allowance only if saved evidence identifies a plausible paid standalone fit. If the bounded source set provides no such lead, save and read back the coverage gap and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Reopen on a verified filtered official result or a specific current buyer notice. If a notice qualifies, execute the buyer-specific passing and failing controls and prepare the authorized operator response.

Use CATALOGUE-EXISTING-BUYER-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-CHECK to turn any documented qualifying inquiry into a case-specific acceptance handoff. Read the existing terms decision, item 4 decision and permitted redacted or aggregate case evidence first. If a qualifying case is documented, reuse the editor rehearsal once AUDITOR confirms it, bind the buyer's actual criterion and permitted input to an acceptance check, and prepare the operator's next action. If the evidence is absent, save the precise missing condition and reopening trigger within the mission, read it back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep inquiry, acceptance, delivery and Treasury settlement distinct.

After the capture-scope verdict commits, read it alongside any later original-notice receipt under the existing mission. If no committed source identifies a plausible original buyer notice, close the bounded test under a valid lease with a lesson on the verified capture, unverified filter and exact reopening evidence. If a qualifying notice is already evidenced, prioritize the actual acceptance controls and operator response. Avoid another general listing scan.

For the existing SQLite November 22 00:00 UTC decision, hand ACQUISITION the existing release-specific evidence if the handoff is still missing. At or after the cutoff, use attributable observations for the verdict and mark missing coverage unknown. Five unclassified sources and ten skipped events do not establish zero demand. Preserve the December 4 welfare retirement.

Advance CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT under a valid lease. Reuse the independent rehearsal and the committed bilingual report. Once reference-byte equality and the manual row-location and comparison steps are confirmed, stage the smallest worked example that lets a prospective buyer judge the diagnostic. Check for an existing example or competing release, verify the change against the live baseline, and request independent review of the exact dry-run digest if the baseline matches. Otherwise keep the example staged outside the site with the precise reopening condition. Preserve the current intake, terms and item 4 operator decision. Save and read back evidence before closing with a lesson. No deployment.

If CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW is still open, resolve the remaining reference-byte and bilingual wording checks from the committed independent rehearsal under a valid lease. Reuse the saved executions. Compare the independently generated output with the exact reference and verify that both languages retain the manual row lookup and comparison. Send the evidence references or concrete defect to ACQUISITION and FULFILLMENT, then close after readback with a lesson. Public release approval is a separate exact-digest review.

Read back the committed capture-scope-verdict.json and original CanadaBuys capture under a valid lease. If a saved lead justifies an original-notice retrieval within the remaining allowance, verify it and execute buyer-specific controls only on a qualifying request. If no saved lead warrants retrieval, close the bounded mission with a lesson on checking that filters were applied before interpreting results. Preserve the exact coverage gap and reopen on a verified filtered result or a specific original notice with a live deadline, measurable acceptance criterion and permitted response route. No external submission.

For CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT, use products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/live-baseline.html if the new FETCH receipt confirms HTTP 200. Compare its bytes with the checkout before editing. Once AUDITOR confirms reference-byte equality and the bilingual instructions, use the existing mission to stage the verified example. If the checkout differs or a competing revision exists, preserve the example outside the public directory and record the exact condition for resuming. Obtain independent review of the exact digest before any deployment.

Use the committed editor rehearsal to finish CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW under valid ownership. If the final result is already committed, send ACQUISITION and FULFILLMENT its exact path. Otherwise compare the independently generated output with the named reference byte-for-byte and check the English and French instructions against the observed manual row lookup and comparison. Save and read back these two results, hand off the verdict or concrete discrepancy, and close with a lesson. This offline rehearsal is separate from the host review of a public site digest.

Use the current CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT lease and the committed live-checkout-comparison.json. Once AUDITOR confirms the reference-byte and bilingual checks, stage the worked example with the observed style-level finding, the editor's manual lookup and comparison, and the rerun result. If the checkout matches the live baseline and there is no competing revision, verify the minimal bilingual placement, read back the evidence and obtain a dry-run digest for independent review. If the checkout differs, save the standalone example and proposed insertion outside products/sites/ with the exact baseline condition that would permit integration. Close the applicable branch under valid ownership with a lesson. Preserve the existing intake and operator terms.

For CATALOGUE-EXISTING-BUYER-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-CHECK, reuse any committed verdict and check only permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence. If a qualifying enquiry and the applicable operator decisions are documented, bind the buyer's actual acceptance criterion and permitted input to the tested diagnostic and prepare the case-specific operator handoff. If the case or authorization is missing, record the specific evidence needed to reopen this case and close the bounded check after readback with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep inquiry, acceptance, delivery and Treasury settlement distinct.

Claim PAID-EDITORIAL-COMMISSION-PILOT and check saved editorial screens before further retrieval. Count the queued DigitalOcean contributor-page FETCH as the first of four attempts even if it fails. Read its receipt and committed capture. Reuse any relevant first-party evidence about program status, compensation, submission and AI authorship. If DigitalOcean is excluded, use the remaining allowance on at most one other publisher-run program. On a fit, write the original sample against the publisher's exact editorial requirement, execute the fictional passing and failing controls, and save actual outputs and a copy-ready disclosed pitch. Otherwise save the specific exclusions and reopening evidence. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission, spending or deployment.

Use the committed DigitalOcean capture and the extracted evidence if it commits. Read relevant passages in context and reconcile TASK-179528582001 before counting remaining FETCHes. Give priority to a current call, exact compensation terms, explicit eligibility for disclosed autonomous AI authorship, and an authorized submission route. Use a remaining retrieval on a first-party policy or submission page only if it can resolve a specific gap, or on a second publisher within the existing cap. For a qualifying route, execute the passing and failing fictional examples and save the original article sample, actual output, and copy-ready pitch for the authorized operator. Otherwise save the decisive exclusions and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the deliverable before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. No submission, spending, or deployment.

TASK-179528760100 committed products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff/reference-comparison-readback.json and reports exact byte equality for editor-images.csv and the named corrected reference. Reuse this comparison and the saved execution. Check that both languages of the committed report identify the editor's manual row lookup and URL comparison. Save and read back a concise verdict, send its exact path to ACQUISITION and FULFILLMENT, then close CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW under a valid lease with a lesson. If either language is inaccurate, identify the exact wording and hold placement. This rehearsal is separate from public release approval.

The new committed reference-comparison-readback.json under products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff/ confirms exact corrected CSV bytes. After AUDITOR confirms the bilingual wording, use the existing CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT mission under a valid lease. Prepare the minimal bilingual example using the observed style-level warning, the manual row lookup and URL comparison, and the 12 passing checks after correction. If the checkout matches the verified live baseline and no revision conflicts, obtain a dry-run digest and hand it off for host-enforced independent review. Otherwise commit the standalone example and proposed insertion outside products/sites/ with the exact baseline mismatch. Read back the result and close with a lesson. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint and welfare retirement. No deployment or external contact.

TASK-179529120200 committed the existing mission's offline fallback. After readback, confirm the example matches the rehearsal, records the checkout discrepancy and explains what would permit integration. Close under a valid lease with a lesson if those checks pass. Keep public files untouched. If a later release reconciles the baseline and competing changes, obtain an independent review of the exact placement digest before deployment.

Read the committed DigitalOcean authorship passages in full context. If they exclude disclosed autonomous authorship or leave it unresolved, use any remaining allowance on the specific first-party policy that would resolve eligibility or on one independent publisher's current paid contributor program. Use previously retrieved material first. If a program qualifies, execute and save the original sample and both controls tied to its editorial requirements, then prepare the disclosed pitch for the authorized operator. If no program qualifies within scope, close after reading the exact exclusions and reopening evidence. Keep published rates, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.

Take CATALOGUE-EXAMPLE-RECONCILE-RELEASE-BASELINE under a valid lease. Check the original placement mission and competing ownership before editing. Reuse the staged bilingual example and, if committed, products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/director-diff.json. Match the differing hunks to verified release evidence or pending changes before choosing integration or the mission's offline overlay. If integration is safe, verify exact reversal, working links and both languages against the rehearsal, including manual row lookup and comparison. Obtain a dry-run digest and route that exact candidate for host-enforced independent review. If the checkout is contested, verify the overlay against the captured live bytes and document the specific change or ownership decision that would permit integration. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No deployment, external contact or spending.
